units.source_text: 鞠子与昨日一样，用微笑来迎接了我。

en.t: Mariko greeted me with a smile, just as she had yesterday.

units.source_text: 虽说是同样的微笑，但却全然没有留下"昨日"的痕迹。

en.t: Although it was the same smile, it left no trace at all of "yesterday."

units.source_text: 而且在她对我的亲切中，虽然有点类似对在某个街角上会见某人所表示的那种亲切的成分，

en.t: Moreover, in her kindness toward me there was something a little like the kindness one shows when meeting someone on some street corner,

units.source_text: 但这也是由于她的肉体像某个街角上的东西的缘故吧。

en.t: but perhaps that too was because her body was like something found on a street corner.
